title: Binder Lead Times for Homeowners Insurance Placements
content:
The binder lead time is the number of calendar days before the scheduled closing date by which the binder on a Homeowners Insurance policy should be issued. It is set by the HomeShield program.

| Program | Binder lead time (calendar days before the scheduled closing date) |
|---|---|
| HomeShield Essential | 10 |
| HomeShield Standard | 10 |
| HomeShield Plus | 10 |
| HomeShield Preferred | 14 |
| HomeShield Premier | 14 |
| HomeShield Estate | 21 |

The lead time grows with the program: 10 days for the three lower programs, 14 days for HomeShield Preferred and Premier, and 21 days for HomeShield Estate.

**Illustration (hypothetical closing).** For a home scheduled to close on the 30th day of a month, a lead time of 10 days points to the 20th of that month, a lead time of 14 days to the 16th, and a lead time of 21 days to the 9th.
